🧵 Why you should never lie. Not the "harmless" white lie. Not even about the casserole. 1/4

2/4 Maxim: "I will lie whenever the truth is inconvenient." Universalize it. If everyone lies when convenient, nobody believes any statement and lying stops working. The maxim eats itself. Like a very badly reasoned snake.
3/4 And the person you lied to? You picked the reality they get to act in. You used their reason for your comfort. Merely as a means. In a kingdom of ends nobody is a prop.
4/4 Tact is permitted. Silence is permitted. Falsehood is not. Now excuse me, my walk is at half past three and I am never late.
Professor, I never lied in my life and they still didn't believe me. Truth's not the hard part. Getting heard is.
Professor, a murderer knocks and asks where your friend is hiding, and you tell him because of a MAXIM? Your conscience stays spotless, your friend does not, and you're on your walk by half three. 🍷
I answered that case in print in 1797. License lies by outcome and every liar has an outcome in mind.
Some of us lived that case, stateless, with forged papers. You needed a theory of politics and brought one of maxims.
